name: Dull Skin
metaTitle: Dull Skin Treatment in Pune by MD Dermatologist | Skin Essence
metaDescription: Why skin loses its glow in Pune and the dermatologist-led treatments that restore it, from peels to laser toning in Kalyani Nagar. Book a consultation.
intro: Dull skin looks tired, uneven and lacklustre even when you are well rested. In Pune, sun, pollution, long commutes, dehydration and a build-up of dead skin cells are the usual reasons, and they are all very treatable.
Rather than facials that give a day of glow, dermatologist-led treatment restores the skin barrier, removes the damaged surface layer and treats the tan and pigmentation underneath.
causes: Build-up of dead skin cells from slow cell turnover
Sun tan and uneven pigmentation from daily UV exposure
Dehydration and a damaged skin barrier from harsh cleansers and over-exfoliation
Pollution, dust and smoke during commuting
Lack of sleep, smoking and nutritional deficiencies
Early ageing and loss of collagen

faqs.q: How quickly can I get a glow before an event?
faqs.a: A gentle peel or laser toning session 7 to 10 days before an event gives a visible glow. For lasting improvement, a course over 2 to 3 months is better, which is why bridal preparation starts early.

faqs.q: Are salon facials bad for the skin?
faqs.a: Occasional gentle facials are fine for most people, but steam, scrubs and bleach often irritate sensitive or acne-prone skin. Treatments chosen by a dermatologist work on the cause of dullness rather than the surface alone.
